_doc: Magic items' powers beyond their +N (Systems/Enchant.cs). kinds: worth on a hero's sheet and hover text. habitats: elements a site's hoard favours. basic: the plain +1/+2/+3 arms, their hoard weights by bonus. arms: what plain arms add to the watch and the regiments. attune: most magic charms a hero wears. draughts: potions and scrolls that go to a hero's stock (the rest are carried, draughtsMost at most, and drunk on the next delve: their powers are in items). events: finds that open a story instead of being worn. found: the country (site habitats) each piece belongs in; a hoard there turns it up affinity times likelier, elsewhere loot.json offFit.
